info.title: ArcFlow standalone approval / scenario / quote HTTP API
info.description: Checked-in contract, not a deployed Swagger endpoint. No login or single-request GET route is implemented. Stateless HTTP Basic. Every unsafe request requires X-Arcflow-Client: approval-demo. Supplied Origin must match the configured UI origin; cross-site Fetch Metadata is rejected. Credentials are configured by the operator. Request-domain operations enforce live identity, effective-route visibility, stage assignment and applicable business ACLs. Generic people/process GET handlers are authenticated metadata reads.

servers.description: Disposable local demo; use HTTPS outside loopback.

post.summary: Submit or replay a business approval intent
post.description: Authenticated active identity; domain checks exact effective-route visibility and live stage assignment. Quote owner is required to submit; readable revision ACL is additionally enforced. Quote process is fixed. Presence of Idempotency-Key is rejected, including a blank header. Revision is supplied only as business.quoteRevision; returned QuoteView has no revision field.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Exactly one value when present; case-sensitive, no comma-combined value. Same actor/key/normalized intent replays current state; changed intent conflicts.

RequiredIdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
RequiredIdempotencyKey.description: Exactly one value when present; case-sensitive, no comma-combined value. Same actor/key/normalized intent replays current state; changed intent conflicts.
